# Insight UI WebMCP

> A Django adapter by Alpin Insight Solutions that exposes public content, navigation and reviewed actions of Insight UI sites as WebMCP tools. The PyPI package is `insight-ui-webmcp`; it depends on the `ais-webmcp` core rather than shipping its own browser runtime.

This repository is the Django package only. Install it with `uv add insight-ui-webmcp` or `pip install insight-ui-webmcp` (Python 3.12 or later, Django 6.0.4–6.x). Add `insight_ui_webmcp` to `INSTALLED_APPS`, then load `{% webmcp_assets %}` from the `webmcp_tags` library once in the site shell. Optional Insight UI integration is the `ui` extra (`insight-ui-webmcp[ui]`).

Management commands include `webmcp_prepare`, `webmcp_validate`, `webmcp_init`, `webmcp_doctor`, `webmcp_status`, `webmcp_diff`, and `webmcp_export`. Hosts keep control of content, permissions and execution. Consequential tools stay disabled until the host explicitly enables and implements them. `subscribe_newsletter` is written `enabled: false` and this package does not register a submit handler.

The shared manifest schema and `register.js` browser runtime come from the installed `ais-webmcp` core (`ais-webmcp>=0.1.0,<0.3`). This adapter is not the place to install the npm package `@alpininsightsolutions/webmcp`; Django sites use the Core from PyPI. The unscoped npm package `webmcp` is unrelated.

Documentation: <https://insight-ui-webmcp.alpininsight.ai/>
Company website: <https://alpininsight.com>
License: Apache-2.0. WebMCP is a draft of the W3C Web Machine Learning Community Group, not a W3C Standard. This package itself stays Apache-2.0; the optional `ui` extra pulls in Insight UI, which is licensed under AGPL-3.0.

## Documentation

- [Insight UI WebMCP documentation](https://insight-ui-webmcp.alpininsight.ai/): documentation site for this adapter and the ais-webmcp core
- [Newcomer guide](https://insight-ui-webmcp.alpininsight.ai/docs/guide/): which package to use
- [Package comparison](https://insight-ui-webmcp.alpininsight.ai/docs/guide/packages/): ais-webmcp, the npm runtime, and this Django adapter
- [Agents and edge](https://insight-ui-webmcp.alpininsight.ai/docs/guide/agents-and-edge/): how origin registration relates to optional edge integration
- [insight-ui-webmcp guide](https://insight-ui-webmcp.alpininsight.ai/docs/insight-ui-webmcp/): Django adapter overview
- [Installation](https://insight-ui-webmcp.alpininsight.ai/docs/insight-ui-webmcp/installation/): install the adapter and enable it in a Django project
- [Settings](https://insight-ui-webmcp.alpininsight.ai/docs/insight-ui-webmcp/settings/): `WEBMCP_ENABLED`, origin-trial, asset mode, and profiles
- [Management commands](https://insight-ui-webmcp.alpininsight.ai/docs/insight-ui-webmcp/commands/): `webmcp_prepare`, `webmcp_validate`, and the other `webmcp_*` commands
- [Templates](https://insight-ui-webmcp.alpininsight.ai/docs/insight-ui-webmcp/templates/): `{% webmcp_assets %}`, `{% webmcp_attribution %}`, and related tags
- [Profiles](https://insight-ui-webmcp.alpininsight.ai/docs/insight-ui-webmcp/profiles/): host profiles such as the shipped `webpage` profile
- [README](https://github.com/alpininsight/insight-ui-webmcp/blob/develop/README.md): setup, settings, output schemas, and declarative forms

## Package source

- [insight-ui-webmcp on PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/insight-ui-webmcp/): install with `pip install insight-ui-webmcp` or `uv add insight-ui-webmcp`
- [Adapter source](https://github.com/alpininsight/insight-ui-webmcp/tree/develop/src/insight_ui_webmcp): Django app, profiles, and helpers
- [Template tags](https://github.com/alpininsight/insight-ui-webmcp/blob/develop/src/insight_ui_webmcp/templatetags/webmcp_tags.py): `webmcp_assets`, `webmcp_attribution`, and the experimental declarative form helper
- [Management commands](https://github.com/alpininsight/insight-ui-webmcp/tree/develop/src/insight_ui_webmcp/management/commands): `webmcp_prepare`, `webmcp_validate`, `webmcp_init`, `webmcp_doctor`, `webmcp_status`, `webmcp_diff`, and `webmcp_export`
- [webpage profile](https://github.com/alpininsight/insight-ui-webmcp/blob/develop/src/insight_ui_webmcp/profiles/webpage.py): shipped read-only tools such as `list_sections` and `get_section`
- [Declarative forms notes](https://github.com/alpininsight/insight-ui-webmcp/blob/develop/docs/declarative-api.md): experimental helper for the still-non-normative declarative API
- [pyproject.toml](https://github.com/alpininsight/insight-ui-webmcp/blob/develop/pyproject.toml): package metadata and the `ais-webmcp` dependency
